paper_title: A New Bound on Axion-Like Particles
coupling_convention: canonical g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis
notes: Astrophysical bound from ALP-photon conversion in Virgo cluster magnetic field using Chandra X-ray spectrum of M87. Conservative model gives g_agamma < 2.6e-12 GeV^-1 (95% CL) for m_a <= 1e-13 eV; benchmark model gives 1.49e-12, stronger models 1.1-1.5e-12. Bound is essentially flat for m_a < 3e-12 eV, weakening above. Reported here the headline conservative value as a mass-independent (flat) line over the light-ALP validity range.
